answer: Answering a complex message takes longer than answering a simple one, and the latency gap is stable per operator. The network measures response latency against message complexity — length, questions asked, decisions needed — and flags a session whose latency does not grow with complexity, because a bot answers both at the same speed. Even a quiet ridge gets heard, because consistency weighs patterns, not volume. A crystal alone is noise; a terrace of consistent sessions is a pattern the network can trust.
